input.prompt: Create a precise 4 by 4 animation sprite sheet for a cozy matcha cafe game. Exactly sixteen equal cells, ordered left to right then top to bottom, one continuous action. Same warm hand-painted anime storybook style as the reference, clean brown outlines, soft morning light. Flat uniform cream background in every cell. Identical camera, scale, and crop. Show only the objects named below. No hands, no fingers, no arms, no sleeves, no person, no face. No extra tools, bottles, bowls, flowers, petals, trays, kettles, or counter clutter beyond the named objects. No cell borders, text, numbers, labels, or UI. Only one milk bottle, one tall glass already holding ice, and the white milk stream. The bottle tilts by itself with no hand. Milk rises in even steps and stops below the rim. No other bottles or tools.
